beginner.title: Get started with QLab
beginner.outcome: You can: set up QLab, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Enter notes quickly
beginner.outcome: You can: write a melody in QLab

beginner.title: Lyrics, chords and dynamics
beginner.outcome: You can: add the details musicians need
beginner.practice: Add lyrics and chords to your melody

intermediate.title: Arrange for several parts
intermediate.outcome: You can: write for choir, band or orchestra
intermediate.practice: Arrange a song for four voices

intermediate.title: Layout and printing
intermediate.outcome: You can: produce clean, readable scores
intermediate.practice: Export a full score and parts

intermediate.title: Signature skills in QLab
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make QLab distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced QLab
expert.outcome: You can: use QLab's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Professional engraving
expert.practice: Engrave a full piece to publication standard

expert.title: Integrate QLab into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect QLab with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect QLab to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use QLab well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use QLab" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
